We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer with a strong focus on AI systems to join our team. This role centers on designing, building, and maintaining AI\-driven services and agentic workflows, with hands\-on Anthropic SDK/API experience as a core requirement. The ideal candidate blends prompt engineering skill, comfort building and debugging agentic loops, and solid full\-stack fundamentals (Python, TypeScript/React, SQL). This person should think about both software\-engineering discipline and AI\-system behavior: testing, scaling, and securing AI\-backed applications the same way any production system would be.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, deploy web applications, AI\-driven services and agentic pipelines (tool\-use loops, multi\-step agents, orchestration)
* Build and maintain integrations with Anthropic API/SDK (Claude models, tool use, prompt caching, streaming)
* Write, iterate, and evaluate prompts for reliability, safety, and cost efficiency
* Develop RESTful APIs (Python) and React/TypeScript front ends around AI features
* Own DevOps for AI services: CI/CD, containerization (Docker), cloud deploy (AWS/Azure), monitoring/observability for agent runs
* Write optimized SQL against relational DBs
* Design automated test frameworks for both deterministic code and non\-deterministic AI outputs (eval harnesses, regression suites)
* Collaborate cross\-functional with teams and translate business needs into AI\-backed technical solutions
* Maintain technical docs (architecture, prompt design decisions, agent behavior/limits)



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 2\+ years of experience working with Python and Flask or Django
* Must\-have: Hands on experience with Anthropic SDK/API and Claude Console
* Proficiency with Git
* Strong experience with RESTful API development
* Hands\-on experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., MySQL, MSSQL, Postgres)
* Comfortable building and debugging agentic loops (tool\-call cycles, multi\-turn agents, error recovery, self\-verification patterns)
* Judgment to scope an AI solution appropriately — knows when multi\-agent orchestration is overkill versus warranted
* Some DevOps exposure: Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms like AWS or Azure
* Proficiency with Git
* Familiarity with testing libraries (pytest, jest); LLM eval framework experience a plus
* Strong debugging skills for complex, partially non\-deterministic systems
* Excellent communication skills: ability to explain AI behavior, limits, and tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders
* Stays current with the broader AI landscape — local/open\-source models, emerging tooling, and alternatives to hosted APIs — and can speak to tradeoffs (cost, latency, privacy, quality) between running a model locally versus calling a hosted API
